title: fumaria agraria var. atlantica
intro: Fumaria agraria var. atlantica, commonly known as a variety of Fumaria species, is a plant belonging to the fumitory family and is a type of flowering plant found in certain regions. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of conditions such as fever, bronchitis, and rheumatism, due to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Fumaria agraria var. atlantica include its ability to reduce fever, relieve cough and respiratory issues, and alleviate pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
